value.deck: A large-scale supply chain attack resulted in terabytes of credentials being leaked, affecting numerous organizations and highlighting the ongoing risks in software supply chains.
shortVersion: A large-scale supply chain attack resulted in terabytes of credentials being leaked, affecting numerous organizations and highlighting the ongoing risks in software supply chains.
Supply chain attacks remain one of the most dangerous threat vectors for developers; this incident is a reminder to audit third-party dependencies and rotate credentials regularly.
